ed8cf924ec8b69ae.reason: Upstream YecWallet's manual connection (Edit -> Settings, used only when the wallet does not read ycash.conf): the rpcpassword of a node the user configured by hand, kept in the per-user QSettings beside host and user. It is the same credential ycash.conf holds in plain text, not a wallet key or seed; there is nowhere else to persist it without an OS keychain dependency. Risk taken knowingly; moving it to the OS keychain is a separate change.

rule_paths.reason: Test fixtures and documentation examples, not secrets (checked 2026-10-23): MEMBER_KEY in the QTest suites is a made-up compressed public key with a sequential hex pattern, and docs/yellowback-rpc-contract.json's example keyid is a sequential placeholder. A secret anywhere else is still reported.

contrib/secops/code-scanning-triage.py runs gh api as an argv list without a shell; the arguments are constants plus the repository name the code-scanning workflow supplies, and the script runs only inside that workflow. Same acceptance as the other workspace repos (checked 2026-10-24).
